full_judgment: 30. In the present case, it was absolutely necessary for BMDC to complete the verification process within one year of the conclusion of the admission test, more so when the list of students admitted in the first year was sent to them by the College within four months after the admission test. However, without doing so, they remained silent and took no action and after a period of almost three years, they issued the impugned Memo. However, in the absence of the examination-sheet, the decision of BMDC as to the alleged manipulation of the result by the petitioner, is not tenable as the same is not supported by any documentary evidence. This admitted position leads us to the conclusion that the impugned memo dated 13-6-2016 was issued by BMDC upon mere presumption. In other words, BMDC was not able to verify or ascertain the actual marks obtained by the petitioner and therefore, upon mere presumption, issued the impugned memo. In our view, such an arbitrary action cannot be sustained.
